hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); PROMPT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.prompt // empty'); SESSION=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s); DIR="/home/fael/so/repos/ben-prototype/.claude/prompt-history/$DATE/$SESSION"; mkdir -p "$DIR"; echo "$PROMPT" > "$DIR/$TIMESTAMP.md"

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/\.claude/plans/'; then DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s); BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); DIR="/home/fael/so/repos/ben-prototype/.claude/plans-history/$DATE"; mkdir -p "$DIR"; cp "$FILE" "$DIR/${TIMESTAMP}-${BASENAME}" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

INPUT=$(cat); SESSION=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s); DIR="/home/fael/so/repos/ben-prototype/.claude/prompt-history/$DATE/$SESSION"; mkdir -p "$DIR"; echo "$INPUT" | jq '{questions: .tool_input.questions, answers: .tool_response.answers}' > "$DIR/${TIMESTAMP}-askuserquestion.json"
